why: rclrs's owned/borrowed split inside its guard condition, so one can be built from a foreign `rcl_guard_condition_t`. our RMW seam is the vtable (RFC-0035), not an entity accessor. See `c:node_get_rmw_handle`. Ours is always executor-owned: `Executor::register_guard_condition(closure)` allocates the flag in the arena and hands back the handle.
